scripts.docker:build: docker build -f ../../Dockerfile --build-arg APP=react-tailwind-node --build-arg GIT_REVISION=$(git rev-parse HEAD) --build-arg BUILD_DATE=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) --sbom=true --provenance=mode=max -t react-tailwind-node:latest -t react-tailwind-node:$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) ../..
scripts.docker:start: docker run --rm --name react-tailwind-node --read-only --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --memory 512m --pids-limit 256 -p 127.0.0.1:8787:8787 react-tailwind-node
scripts.docker:clean: docker rm -f react-tailwind-node && docker images -q react-tailwind-node | sort -u | xargs -r docker image rm -f
scripts.docker:scan: docker run --rm -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock aquasec/trivy:latest image --quiet --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --ignore-unfixed --exit-code 1 react-tailwind-node:latest
